title: Winsorize
seoDescription: Winsorization clips extreme values in each column to percentile-based bounds, a standard technique for suppressing outliers in ML preprocessing.
description:
Replace extreme numerical values below lower percentile p_low and above upper percentile p_high with boundary percentiles.

Winsorizing limits the distorting influence of heavy-tailed outliers on sample variance and mean estimation without discarding sample count.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
x'_i = \begin{cases} Q(p_{\text{low}}) & x_i < Q(p_{\text{low}}) \\ Q(p_{\text{high}}) & x_i > Q(p_{\text{high}}) \\ x_i & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Calculate empirical lower percentile value Q(p_low)
2. Calculate empirical upper percentile value Q(p_high)
3. Clip array values into range [Q(p_low), Q(p_high)] and round to 4 decimal places

### Returns
List of floats representing Winsorized dataset.

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
The implementation computes **Winsorize** by following direct mathematical principles, leveraging vectorized operations to ensure both correctness and optimal runtime efficiency.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def numpy_winsorize(data: list, p_low: float = 5.0, p_high: float = 95.0) -> list:
    arr = np.array(data, dtype=float)
    return np.round(np.clip(arr, np.percentile(arr, p_low), np.percentile(arr, p_high)), 4).tolist()
```

### ⏱️ Complexity Analysis
- **Time Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N)$ where $N$ represents the size of the primary input.
- **Space Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N)$ auxiliary memory for computing and storing output representations.
